facts.text: RawARCEnv's constructor defaults are max_grid_size (30, 30), colors 10 and max_trial -1
The observation space is a Dict of trials_remain, terminated, input, input_dim, grid and grid_dim
The state document carries trials_remain (max_trial), terminated 0, the zero-padded input and grid, input_dim and grid_dim
The action space is a Dict of a selection Box with 0 or 1 on every grid cell and an operation Discrete over the operation count
RawARCEnv's operations are ten color operations (0-9), resize_to_answer (10) and submit (11)
The reward is 1 only when the last operation is submit and the visible grid equals the answer; otherwise it is 0
step applies the operation, increments action_steps, updates info steps and returns the state, reward, terminated, truncated and info
A submit decrements trials_remain, terminates when the grid equals the answer, and terminates when trials_remain reaches 0
reset passes seed and options to gym.Env.reset, accepts prob_index, subprob_index, adaptation and reset_on_submit, and draws the problem from the data loader
The reset info carries the zero-padded input and answer with their dimensions
ARCLE/RawARCEnv-v0 is registered with entry point arcle.envs.arcenv:RawARCEnv and without max_episode_steps

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the synthetic problem of the next reset and the transition model is deterministic, so the same seed and action sequence repeat a trajectory; the fake draws with Python's random.Random while upstream draws with numpy's np_random, so a seed selects an index but not necessarily the same problem as upstream

gaps: discrete ARC grid transitions only: no physics, dynamics or continuous time, so timestep_ms is 0 (the event-driven analytic value) and each tick is one operation
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks never sleep
the fake uses a small synthetic problem table in place of the ARCLoader datasets; the loader, the pygame/ANSI rendering and the dataset split are not modelled
the fake uses Python lists and random.Random where upstream uses numpy int8 arrays and np_random
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
